title: refactor(service-storage): the storage download door calls the one request-to-ExecutionContext composition, resolveRequestExecutionContext
body:
Part of #23217

Clause-②: no
Ruling-ref: 6227928430

Basis for the `Clause-②` line: the ruling's "later slices `Clause-②: no`". The storage door's outward answers are unchanged (a 12-row ADR-0096 / ADR-0069 pin and a 47-wiring fault probe read the same on both trees), and no export moves in `@objectstack/service-storage`. The function's export landed in slice 1.

Slice 4 of #23217 under ruling record 6227928430 (letter A): the storage door, the download authorizer `buildFileReadAuthorizer` in `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts`, calls the one `resolveRequestExecutionContext` that slice 1 landed in `@objectstack/core`. `@objectstack/core`'s function is not touched (patch round 1 corrects two rows of its module docblock table, comment text only): every difference of the download door is one of the function's existing named parameters, so letter B does not arise for it. The card stays open: slice 5 (`plugin-hono-server`) remains, and the storage family's ADR-0069 gate reader is an item-3 question (below), not converted.

## What changed

### The door

`buildFileReadAuthorizer` keeps its door facts and calls the function once. Each parameter was measured on the hand-written door (`origin/main` `68a090fb9`, door blob `ff2307ad9`) before converting:

| parameter | the download door passes | what the hand-written door did |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `anonymous` | `'fail-closed'` | no `userId` answered `'unauthenticated'` (401 `AUTH_REQUIRED`); unchanged |
| `authGate` | `'resolved'` | handed on the raw context, whose `authGate` is the posture the admitting read decided. The family door's gate reader runs first, so this door is not a second gate; `'reread-when-active'` would read the session a third time and add a 503 arm this door never had |
| `credentials` | `'api-key-and-session'` | the real request headers, so `x-api-key` is honoured |
| `sessionApi` | `'optional'` | an auth service with no session read still admits a key. With no auth service at all there is no authorizer (a door fact, unchanged) |
| `session` | `'request'` | the auth service's in-process read |
| `tenancy` | its own resolver, `tenancyServiceResolver(registry)` | the async accessor when the host has one (#15352, #16013); the resolution stays at the door |
| `localization`, `requestLocale` | `'withhold'`, `undefined` | none resolved |
| `accessToken` | `'carry'` | the raw context carried the session bearer to the owner read and to a file-access delegate (`session.accessToken` for a hook) |
| `oauth`, `onAdmission` | `undefined` | none |

Door facts that stay at the door: the auth-service lookup (once per binding, as the gate reader does it), the header normalisation, the tenancy wiring, the owner shortcut, the owner-record and attachment-parent reads, and the fail-closed `catch` that re-raises the two brands.

The tenancy wiring was split as settings' was: `tenancyServiceResolver(registry)` is the door's way to the service, handed to the function; the gate reader's `resolveAdmissionTenancyPosture` now classifies through the same resolver. The private `GateAuthService` type became `@objectstack/core`'s `RequestAuthService`, the slice of the auth service the function reads.

### What the door hands on

The context that reaches `readableFieldOwners` (the owner-record read and a `fileAccessDelegate` service) and the attachment-parent reads is now the assembled `ExecutionContext` envelope instead of the raw `ResolvedAuthzContext`. Measured on every resolved row of the probe: the key set gains `isSystem` (false) and `principalKind` (`'human'`) and loses `credential`; every other key and value is the same. Readers measured on `origin/main`: no source under `packages/objectql`, `plugin-security`, `plugin-sharing` or `plugin-approvals` reads `context.credential`; no reader compares `isSystem` with `false` or `undefined`; `principalKind` is read for `'guest'`, `'agent'`, `'service'` and `'system'` only (plus the security plugin's memo key, which is a cache key); the one file-access delegate (`ApprovalService.authorizeFileRead`) is typed for `ExecutionContext` already. No door-side projection is needed: the door itself reads only `userId`.

### Readers moved in the same PR

- `packages/core/src/security/authz-store-unavailable.test.ts`: the storage row of `TRANSPORT_LEDGER` left (the file no longer holds `resolveAuthzContext({`), and the composition's comment names the fourth door.
- `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs`: `DELEGATORS` gained the storage row (`resolveRequestExecutionContext`).
- `packages/runtime/src/security/request-execution-context.conformance.test.ts`: a `STORAGE_ROW` with its own capture point (the read of the record that owns a private field-owned file, through the real `GET /files/:fileId/url` on the booted plugin), and a storage CONTROL. `DoorRow` gained `answeredBeforeComposition`: the storage door answers two requests before its composition runs (its family gate refuses the held session while a gate is active, and a host with no auth service binds no authorizer), so the row declares them, hands nothing on for them, and the CONTROL reads the answer the door gave (403 `PASSWORD_EXPIRED`; 200 served unasked). The world fixture gained the owned file, the owner object, a `findOne`, and an auth service without a session read; the storage `sessionApi` is told apart there. `Request` gained `held`.
- `packages/runtime/package.json`: `@objectstack/service-storage` as a devDependency (no workspace cycle: its 18-package closure, devDependencies included, never reaches `@objectstack/runtime`; `check:workspace-manifest-cycles` exit 0), `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated by `pnpm install` (+3 lines), and an anchored test-only alias in `packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts` (`check:test-source-alias`).
- `scripts/slot-lookup-baseline.json`: not touched. `buildGetSession`'s any-typed lookup is still reached by its two other readers, and `check:slot-lookup` holds at 5 for the file.
- No service-storage test read the door's source text, so nothing was re-aimed.

### The pin (ruling item 2)

`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.request-context-door.pin.test.ts` boots the real plugin, drives `GET /files/:fileId/url` for a private field-owned file, and reads what reached the service (which context the owner-record read received, and whether the adapter minted a capability). 12 rows: four ADR-0096 refusals (no credential, an unknown cookie, a failed session read with no gate active, an ex-member's key beside a cookie), four ADR-0069 rows (a held session 403, a failed re-read under an active gate 503, a held owner's key 403, a key beside a held cookie answers for its owner), the held session served with no gate active carrying the admitting read's posture, two CONTROLs (an ungated session carrying its bearer; a key on a host whose auth service has no session read) and the wiring row (no auth service: served unasked).

## Evidence

All on a shared container; lock seconds are shared-box readings.

- The pin on the hand-written door (`d2888fa3d`, door blob `ff2307ad9`): `Tests 13 passed (13)` (the pin's 12 plus the one-off probe), and on the converted door (`0d76d89eb`, door blob `1bdd64a15`): `Tests 13 passed (13)`.
- A one-off fault probe (never committed) drove the booted plugin's download route on 47 wirings (tenancy outage, unregistered or no async registry; permission store, key store or owner object throwing; auth service absent, without a session API, `getApi` rejecting, its session read throwing, its gate probe throwing, its posture computation or key policy throwing, and its registry lookup throwing only after boot; held sessions and held owners' keys with the gate active and inactive; revoked, refused and org-less keys, alone and beside cookies). `diff` of the before and after readings: IDENTICAL on all 47 answers (status, code, who the owner read was asked as, capability minted). The only difference is the context's key set described above, plus one row: with the auth service's registry lookup throwing after boot and a held owner's key under an inactive gate, the context now carries the owner's `authGate`, because the door asks the auth service it bound for the posture where it used to look it up again per request; the verdict and the answer are unchanged (200, read as the key's owner).
- ABLATION, declared direction RED, at `f24d8a103` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` inside the verify lock (both suites read the door from `src`: relative imports in the package, the runtime alias): leg 1 `authGate: 'resolved',` to `'withhold'` (marker `ABLATION-23217-s4-gate`, on disk marker 1 / anchor 0): pin `Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, conformance `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)`. Leg 2 `accessToken: 'carry',` to `'withhold'` (marker `ABLATION-23217-s4-bearer`): pin `Tests 2 failed | 10 passed (12)`, conformance `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)`. Each restore: blob equals HEAD (`1bdd64a15`) and `git diff HEAD` empty, marker 0. Observed direction equals declared.

## Tests (HEAD `f24d8a103`, after merging `origin/main` `dd72a047f`)

- `@objectstack/service-storage`: `Test Files 60 passed (60)`, `Tests 1041 passed (1041)`; `typecheck` exit 0 (test layer 0 / 0 / 0 held), and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: the conformance test, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 11 passed (11)` (6 requests, the identity test, 4 CONTROLs); `typecheck` exit 0 (test layer 27 files / 190 errors / 68 signatures held, none in the conformance file). The rest of the runtime suite was not run locally: no other runtime test imports `@objectstack/service-storage` (only comments and strings name it), the alias is anchored, and CI's Test Core runs it.
- `@objectstack/core`: the repo-project ledger `src/security/authz-store-unavailable.test.ts`, `Tests 37 passed (37)` (38 before, minus the storage row); `typecheck` exit 0 (test layer 4 / 4 / 4 held). Core's code is untouched; patch round 1 (`e2891bfbc`) edits two docblock table rows.
- Build: `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=2` after the merge, `76 successful, 76 total`.

## Gates (HEAD `f24d8a103`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 102 commands; each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe. 101 exited 0 on the first pass; `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: its closure build did not get a turn on the verify lock), and was re-run under the lock on the same head: exit 0 (`none above its recorded number`). `--ran`: `102 derived, 102 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0. Among them `check:authz-resolver`, `check:slot-lookup` (`100 unswept site(s) in 25 file(s), none new`), `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:workspace-manifest-cycles`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 0 on the built tree), `check:dts-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`.
- The declared wide population (`dispatch-gates.mjs` with the changed paths, no `--commands`): all 11 families run, all exit 0: `check:init-service-contract`, `check:live-db-isolation`, `check:meta-type-normalized`, `check:optional-error-sink`, `check:resume-authority-declared`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:runner-env-posture`, `check:settings-bind-window`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:verify-stand-in`, `check:wildcard-fallthrough`. Also `check:adr-anchors` and `check:adr-symbol-anchors` exit 0, and `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0.
- Edited gate script: `node scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs` exit 0 and `--self-test` exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the six changed `.ts` / `.mjs` files: exit 0, no output.

## Item-3 question, not converted: the storage family's ADR-0069 gate reader

`buildAuthGateSessionReader` runs before every storage route (`mountFamilyRoute`). It re-composes the function's gate decision beside it: the key arm (`resolveApiKeyAdmission` with the door's posture, a held key answers its owner's posture) and, while `isAuthGateActive()`, a session re-read whose failure is `AuthzStoreUnavailableError('auth_gate')`. That is `decideAuthGate`'s `'reread-when-active'` arm plus `resolveAuthzContext`'s key arm, so it is a second copy of the gate decision. The one function cannot carry it as an existing parameter without changing answers: the probe asked the function, with storage's parameters and `'reread-when-active'`, what the gate reader decides on the same 45 applicable wirings, and they differ on 14 (the function resolves the whole principal even with no gate active, so a tenancy, permission-store or posture outage becomes a 503 on every storage route; an active gate whose re-read fails is a 503 at the gate and a pass in the function, whose first read swallows the failure; the key arm differs too, detail withheld with #24366). So it was not converted. The seat's decision (review `6252129939`): it stays as it is on this card; the gap is #24366, where a parity pin or a gate-only mode is decided. The card's acceptance (`git grep -c` of the composition's distinctive lines reads 0 in the five files) therefore does not yet read 0 for `storage-service-plugin.ts`: `resolveApiKeyAdmission(` and `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture(` remain there, in the gate reader.

## Acceptance notes

- Patch round 1 (review `6252129939`, `e2891bfbc`): `@objectstack/core`'s module docblock table (`request-execution-context.ts`) named the storage family door under `authGate: 'reread-when-active'` and only the dispatcher under `accessToken: 'carry'`, which this slice made false. Both rows now name the storage download door (`'resolved'`, `'carry'`), with one clause that the family's gate reader stays hand-written (#24366). Comment text only; the file is declared on #6367.
- Measured while answering the item-3 question, and reported to the seat rather than fixed here: an ADR-0069 gate gap on this route family (security). Detail withheld under the maintainer's disclosure ruling (2026-08-18, recorded on #9387) and redacted from this body by the seat; filed as #24366, the storage residual of #23287. It reads identically on `main` and on this PR's head.
- A key-store read failure answering 401 at this door is the known #24299 shape; the probe read it identically on both trees.
